gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies that the R-squared definition and its normalized identities divide by Var(Y), are undefined for an almost surely constant response, and require an explicit Var(Y)>0 condition. This is the same missing nondegeneracy assumption and failed normalization at eq:r2 identified by the gold issue.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries identify the failure to restrict the normalized R-squared definition and identities to the nondegenerate case Var(Y)>0; when Y is almost surely constant, Var(Y)=0 and the normalization is undefined.

component_coverage.gold_component: The active square-integrability assumption permits an almost surely constant response, so Var(Y)=0 and the R-squared normalization and ceiling are undefined unless Var(Y)>0 is imposed.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states that the definition and [0,1] range require Var(Y)>0, explains the constant-response zero-variance case and undefined R-squared, notes the missing source condition, and supplies the corresponding repair.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns failure to test the joint out-of-basis subspace because small individual probe effects can accumulate, whereas the gold issue concerns the separate multiple-testing obligation to adjust the per-probe cutoff to control family-wise false positives. Neither the diagnosis nor the proposed joint-subspace repair recognizes the missing Bonferroni correction or the incorrect 1.96 threshold.
